title: On free boundary minimal submanifolds with boundary on concentric spheres in Euclidean spac
summary: The search for free boundary minimal submanifolds in Euclidean space with boundaries on a collection of concentric spheres naturally extends the classical problem in the unit Euclidean ball. A key feature of this setting is that the coordinate functions of such submanifolds satisfy a Steklov problem with an indefinite weight. This framework allows us to introduce a spectral index, which in turn yields both upper and lower bounds for the Morse index.
